mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `groups` ( region_id, member_id, group_name, description, max_members, created_at ) VALUES ( #{regionId}, #{memberId}, #{groupName}, #{description}, #{maxMembers}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() )
INSERT INTO small_group ( group_id, like_category, meet_date, location ) VALUES ( #{groupId}, #{likeCategory}, #{meetDate}, #{location} )
INSERT INTO group_member ( member_id, group_id, member_role, membership_status, joined_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{groupId}, 'OWNER', 'APPROVED', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM small_group sg JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = sg.group_id JOIN region r ON r.region_id = g.region_id

SELECT sg.small_group_id, g.group_id, g.group_name, g.description, r.region_name, g.max_members, sg.like_category, sg.meet_date, sg.location FROM small_group sg JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = sg.group_id JOIN region r ON r.region_id = g.region_id
ORDER BY g.created_at DESC, sg.small_group_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT sg.small_group_id, g.group_id, g.group_name, g.description, r.region_name, sg.like_category, sg.meet_date, sg.location, g.max_members, creator.nickname AS creator_nickname, g.created_at FROM small_group sg JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = sg.group_id JOIN region r ON r.region_id = g.region_id JOIN members creator ON creator.member_id = g.member_id WHERE sg.small_group_id = #{smallGroupId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL AND creator.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND membership_status = 'APPROVED' AND member_role IN ('OWNER', 'MEMBER')

SELECT sg.small_group_id, sg.group_id, g.member_id AS group_creator_member_id, owner.owner_member_id FROM small_group sg JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = sg.group_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT group_id, MAX(member_id) AS owner_member_id FROM group_member WHERE member_role = 'OWNER' AND membership_status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY group_id ) owner ON owner.group_id = g.group_id WHERE sg.small_group_id = #{smallGroupId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT g.group_name, sg.like_category, g.description, g.max_members, sg.meet_date, sg.location, COALESCE(approved.approved_member_count, 0) AS approved_member_count FROM small_group sg JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = sg.group_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS approved_member_count FROM group_member WHERE membership_status = 'APPROVED' AND member_role IN ('OWNER', 'MEMBER') GROUP BY group_id ) approved ON approved.group_id = g.group_id WHERE sg.small_group_id = #{smallGroupId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT sg.small_group_id, sg.group_id, g.member_id AS group_creator_member_id FROM small_group sg JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = sg.group_id WHERE sg.small_group_id = #{smallGroupId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT member_id FROM group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND member_role = 'OWNER' AND membership_status = 'APPROVED' FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND membership_status = 'APPROVED' AND member_role IN ('OWNER', 'MEMBER') FOR UPDATE
